def get_pairs_count(numbers, target_sum):
    # Counts index pairs (i < j) where numbers[i] + numbers[j] == target_sum.
    # Duplicate values count as distinct pairs, so [1, 1, 1, 1] with sum 2 gives C(4, 2) = 6.
    seen = {}  # value -> how many times it has appeared so far
    count = 0
    for x in numbers:
        count += seen.get(target_sum - x, 0)
        seen[x] = seen.get(x, 0) + 1
    return count


assert get_pairs_count([1, 1, 1, 1], 2) == 6
